summary: Complete end-to-end testing of Optimus platform. Backend: 29/29 tests pass. Frontend: All 12 pages load and major flows work. A few minor UX issues found.

ui_bugs.issue: Tab switching (Daily Quiz, Crash Sim, Glossary) screenshots show Articles tab still visually highlighted/active. Tab content does change in DOM but CSS active state may not visually reflect the selected tab. Needs verification.
Page navigation triggers network timeout (10s+) because recharts and multiple API calls prevent networkidle. Page loads fine after waiting. Not a blocker but slow load.

Post creation form UI: the textarea/input field for writing a new post was not easily discoverable. The + button expands something but the textarea wasn't found for automated input. Manual review recommended.

issues: Date fields use browser's native date picker instead of a custom component. Minor UX inconsistency with glassmorphism dark theme.

action_items: Verify LearnHub tab active state CSS updates properly when switching tabs (Daily Quiz, Crash Sim, Glossary)
Consider improving Community post creation UX discoverability
Optional: Replace browser native date picker with custom styled picker in Arena Create Competition form
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 858 lines — approaching file size limit (700). Consider splitting market, portfolio, roadmap, community, algo, and learn into separate routers.

Portfolio performance chart (mockHistory) in Portfolio.js uses Math.random() which changes on every render — values are not deterministic and chart resets on re-render. Consider fixed seed or memoizing.
XP update in /api/user/xp doesn't recalculate level correctly after quiz — level update is done in quiz endpoint separately, creating inconsistency if xp endpoint is called independently.
CORS set to '*' — acceptable for demo but should be restricted for production.
seed_data_creation: Backend API tests modified data: completed lesson-1 in town 1, submitted quiz for town 1 (score 100%, town 2 unlocked), bought/sold stocks, created community post, joined competition, created test competition, ran daily quiz submit. Portfolio was reset at end of test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend 100% pass. All 12 pages load. AI Chatbot (Claude) works. Key flows: Trading Terminal BUY/SELL works, AlgoLab backtest works, Roadmap 12 towns with Town 1 unlocked, Profile shows user data. Main issue to recheck: LearnHub tab visual active state when switching tabs.
mocked_apis: Market data (/api/market/stocks, /api/market/stocks/{symbol}/chart), community leaderboard (/api/community/leaderboard static mock). All other endpoints use real MongoDB.
